programs.title: Ben & Holly's Little Kingdom
programs.desc: Barnaby Elf's uncle, Redbeard the Elf Pirate, comes to visit the Little Kingdom, but he has lost his treasure. Holly, Ben, the Fairies, and the Elves must help Redbeard follow the clues to track down the treasure.

programs.title: Teletubbies
programs.desc: Tinky Winky can't sleep and goes outside to play so as not to wake the other Teletubbies. But Tinky Winky's noisy footsteps, on top of Home Dome, wakes them up!

programs.title: Sesame Street
programs.desc: Tamir is leaving for robotics camp and needs to figure out how to keep the garden watered while he's away. With help from his friends, Tamir makes a drip irrigation system so the community garden can get plenty of water.

programs.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programs.sub_title: Daniel Tries Something New With Grandpere
programs.desc: Daniel is having a special day playing astronauts at Grandpere's house! When Daniel tries to make his snack all by himself, he struggles to spread the peanut butter. Grandpere encourages Daniel to keep trying.

programs.title: Maddie & Triggs
programs.desc: Maddie + Triggs are intrigued when Mum suggests they use the microwave to cook dinner; can this singing robot microwave really make a healthy meal that's delicious and nutritious?

programs.title: Numberblocks
programs.desc: One and Two are off on a camping trip, and together they have fun sharing things equally between them. Can they carry on sharing things fairly when Three and Four join them?

programs.title: Bing
programs.desc: Bing and Sula are painting in the garden. Bing accidentally knocks the water over and tries to refill it, but he turns it on too fast and the hose turns into a big snake, covering them in wet paint!

programs.title: Fizzy And Suds
programs.desc: Brrrmm, brmmm, here we go! Fizzy and Suds get up to speed in the workshop and learn all about fast cars. Let's see how they get spray-painted!

programs.title: Peppa Pig
programs.desc: There is a pet competition at playgroup, and everyone has brought in their pets. Dr Hamster is the judge but finds it hard to choose the best pet.

programs.title: Ready, Steady, Wiggle!
programs.desc: Sing along to 'Rock-a-Bye Your Bear' but look! Lachy has fallen asleep. The Wiggles try to wake him up, and they need your help! Next, come and see what Buddy is getting up to at the beach.

programs.title: Shaun the Sheep
programs.desc: Bitzer tries to lend a hand with some DIY but ends up in a very compromised situation.

programs.title: The Adventures of Paddington
programs.desc: Mateo and Judy form a secret club in the treehouse but won't let Jonathan and Paddington join without a password. Can Paddington discover the secret code word?
